title: Street detective tick list
subject: Geography
unit: Summer 1: My local area, maps and aerial images (Street Detectives)
source: Seeded from geography/y2 lesson 6 (Street detective tick list (portal printable))
intro: Lesson 6: Street detectives: features of my local area. To understand that a local area has human and physical features we can observe and record

questions.model: Did people build grass? No, it grows by itself. So it is physical.

questions.q: Is a bus stop human or physical?
Name a human feature on your street.
questions.a: For example: houses, a shop, a road

questions.q: From your door or window, with an adult, tick each feature you can see and write H or P beside it.
questions.a: A completed tick list from the pupil's own street, each marked H or P
questions.model: Teacher completes the first row with the class photo.

questions.q: What is your street mostly used for: homes, shops or both?
questions.a: For example: mostly homes, with one shop

questions.q: Name one feature you would like to add to your street and why.
questions.a: For example: a bench, so older people can rest

questions.q: Big question: what clues does your street give?
questions.a: For example: lots of houses show people live there; a shop shows people buy things
